metadata.title: Elon Musk revisits Tesla Shanghai factory after 3 years, praises China manufacturing

content.text:
Tesla CEO Elon Musk made a whirlwind 24-hour visit to China, traveling to Shanghai on November 19 after concluding activities related to the APEC meetings in Shenzhen...
